headline: Apple's revamped Health app with AI health coach may debut next month
summary: Rumors of a revamped Health app with an AI health coach were circulating earlier this year, but the project was delayed. It may now arrive with iOS 18.4.
details: Apple's Health app is reportedly getting a significant overhaul, potentially including an AI-powered health coach.
This revamped app was initially rumored to arrive earlier this year, but the project faced delays.
Sources suggest that the new features, including the AI health coach, might be unveiled with the upcoming iOS 18.4 update.
The original rumors pointed to a more comprehensive health tracking and advisory experience, leveraging AI to provide personalized insights and guidance.
caption:
Apple's revamped Health app with an AI health coach could be launching next month.

Apple's Health app is reportedly getting a significant overhaul, potentially including an AI-powered health coach.

This revamped app was initially rumored to arrive earlier this year, but the project faced delays.

The original rumors pointed to a more comprehensive health tracking and advisory experience, leveraging AI to provide personalized insights and guidance.
